if.everyTransaction: [XX-No conditions yet, so this rule applies to every transaction.-XX]

then.limit: [XX-A rule can have at most {max} actions.-XX]

group.notLabel: [XX-Negate this group: it matches when its conditions do not-XX]

value.matchesHint: [XX-Use * for any text, for example *coffee*. A pattern without * matches only the whole text. Use {capture} to keep the text at that spot for the actions of this rule, for example {example}. A name is lowercase letters and digits, and a pattern can keep up to {max} texts.-XX]

action.title: [XX-Action-XX]
action.instructionPlaceholder: [XX-For example, split this purchase by the receipt-XX]
action.instructionHelp: [XX-The rule only asks for a review. A person approves any change before it is made.-XX]
action.onlyIfEmptyHelp: [XX-When on, the rule fills in the category or payee only if the transaction has none. It does not replace one set by hand or by the payee's default category. Turn it off to replace it.-XX]
action.templateHelp: [XX-Plain text. Each placeholder in braces is replaced with text from the transaction. Select a placeholder below to insert it.-XX]
action.joinHelp: [XX-The text is joined to the current description exactly as written, so include any space or separator you want.-XX]
action.placeholdersHelp: [XX-{payeeText} is the payee text as received. {description} is the description as it stands when this action runs. The other placeholders are the captures named in the patterns of this rule.-XX]
action.unknownPlaceholders: [XX-Not defined by this rule: {names}. Choose a placeholder from the list, or capture it in a pattern above.-XX]
action.invalidPlaceholders: [XX-Not a valid placeholder: {names}. A name is lowercase letters and digits.-XX]
action.createIfMissing: [XX-Create the payee if it does not exist-XX]
action.createIfMissingHelp: [XX-When on, and no payee matches the name (by name, alias or a close match), a new payee is created with it. A payee created by a rule is kept if you undo the run.-XX]
action.onlyIfEmptyDescriptionHelp: [XX-When on, the rule writes the description only if the transaction has none. Turn it off to write it every time.-XX]
action.convertHelp: [XX-The matched income or expense becomes one leg of a transfer. The other leg is created in the account you choose, which must use the same currency.-XX]
action.directionTo: [XX-Expense: the money goes to another account-XX]
action.directionFrom: [XX-Income: the money comes from another account-XX]
action.clearCategoryHelp: [XX-A transfer has no category. Turn this off to keep the category the transaction already has.-XX]
action.splitHint: [XX-Each part takes its amount from a capture in the patterns above, or takes the rest. The parts must add up to the amount of the transaction, otherwise the rule leaves it alone.-XX]
action.splitNoCaptures: [XX-No capture is defined yet. Put a name in braces in a pattern above, for example PRINCIPAL: {example}, to use it as an amount here.-XX]
action.partsLimit: [XX-A split can have at most {max} parts.-XX]
action.splitGuideHow: [XX-In “If”, add a condition on the payee text or description with the operator “matches the pattern”, and put names in curly braces where the amounts are, for example {first}. Each name becomes an amount you can pick for a part, or choose “The rest”. The parts must add up to the transaction amount, otherwise the rule leaves the transaction unchanged. A part can be a category or a transfer to another account (a transfer moves the balance of that account).-XX]
action.splitGuidePart1: [XX-Part 1: {first} as a transfer to the loan account-XX]
action.splitGuideResult: [XX-Result for -1500,75: -1200,50 transferred to the loan account and -300,25 of interest expense.-XX]
action.splitGuideTip: [XX-Tip: set a start date under “Active between” so older reconciled transactions are not changed, and use the Test panel before saving.-XX]
action.convertGuide: [XX-An expense becomes a transfer to the account you choose, and an income becomes a transfer from it. Only the balance of the other account changes. Tip: use “Active between” so older transactions are not changed.-XX]

codes.INVALID_SHAPE: [XX-This part is not in a form the editor understands.-XX]
codes.UNKNOWN_KEY: [XX-This part has a setting that does not exist.-XX]
codes.OPERATOR_NOT_ALLOWED: [XX-This field does not allow that operator.-XX]
codes.VALUE_TYPE: [XX-The value is of the wrong kind for this field.-XX]
codes.RANGE_ORDER: [XX-The first value must not be greater than the second.-XX]
codes.MAX_DEPTH: [XX-Groups are nested too deeply. The limit is {maxDepth} levels.-XX]
codes.MAX_LEAVES: [XX-There are too many conditions. The limit is {maxLeaves}.-XX]
codes.MAX_NODES: [XX-There are too many conditions and groups. The limit is {maxNodes}.-XX]
codes.TOO_MANY_ACTIONS: [XX-There are too many actions. The limit is {maxActions}.-XX]
codes.DUPLICATE_ACTION: [XX-A rule can have only one AI review, one transfer or split, and one split part that takes the rest.-XX]
codes.CONFLICTING_ACTIONS: [XX-A transfer or split action cannot be combined with “Set the category”, and each of its parts has either a category or an account.-XX]
codes.INVALID_CAPTURE: [XX-A capture name must be lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, and up to 20 long.-XX]
codes.TOO_MANY_CAPTURES: [XX-A pattern can hold at most 5 captures.-XX]
codes.DUPLICATE_CAPTURE: [XX-Each capture name can be used once in a rule.-XX]
codes.UNKNOWN_CAPTURE: [XX-This uses a capture that no condition of this rule defines.-XX]
codes.LOOKS_LIKE_REGEX: [XX-Regular expressions are not supported: | \ and short bracket classes like [xy] are matched as plain characters, so a pattern written as a regex never matches what was meant. To match one of several texts, add a group of “Any of these” and put one condition in it for each text.-XX]
codes.PATTERN_WITHOUT_WILDCARD: [XX-Without a * this pattern must equal the whole text. Use the operator “is” for the whole text, “contains” for a part of it, or put * around the text, for example *coffee*.-XX]
codes.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: [XX-An item chosen here no longer exists. Choose another.-XX]

expression.label: [XX-Condition expression-XX]
expression.help: [XX-Write the conditions as text. Use && for all of these, || for any of these and !( ... ) for not. Refer to items by name: account("Name"), payee("Name"), category("Parent: Child") and tag("Name"). An underscore _ stands for a value you have not chosen yet. matchesGlob uses * as a wildcard. Only the syntax offered in the suggestions is supported.-XX]
